Both symptoms, one already-fixed bug, zero code change, zero noise cards — the evidence recorded in the PR body where it belongs. The route-spelling observation (`/apps/${name}` vs `appRouteSegment()` — harmless today via alias matching) is noted in this record as a known dual spelling; it stays unfiled until it has a consumer.
